= XML Security
:artifactid: camel-xmlsecurity-starter

Encrypt and decrypt XML payloads using Apache Santuario

* xref:{csb-camel-components}:dataformats:xmlSecurity-dataformat.adoc[XML Security data format]

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.
